name: CheckboxV2
description: An enhanced checkbox component with built-in label and description text support. Renders a real <input type="checkbox"> for accessibility with a custom visual overlay. Supports checked, indeterminate, disabled, and error states.

notes: A real <input type="checkbox"> is rendered and visually hidden; the styled box is a presentation layer.
The indeterminate state is set via the indeterminate DOM property and aria-checked="mixed".
Focus indicator appears on the visual checkbox via :focus-visible using var(--color-border-focus).
When error is true, the border uses var(--color-border-danger).
The label is associated with the input via htmlFor/id pairing.
The description is linked via aria-describedby for screen reader access.
Touch target is at minimum 44px via min-block-size on the wrapper.

onChange.description: Called with the new checked state when toggled.

label.description: Primary label text rendered next to the checkbox.

description.description: Secondary description text rendered below the label.

disabled.description: Disables the checkbox. Prevents interaction and reduces visual emphasis.

indeterminate.description: Whether the checkbox is in an indeterminate state. Sets aria-checked to 'mixed'.

error.description: Shows an error state. Border colour changes to var(--color-border-danger).

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the wrapper element.

do: Always provide a label for accessibility.
Use description to provide additional context when the label alone is insufficient.
Use indeterminate for parent checkboxes in a tree/group that are partially selected.
Use error alongside a visible error message to communicate validation failures.
dont: Do not use indeterminate as a substitute for an unchecked state.
Do not leave a checkbox without a label.
Do not use for mutually exclusive choices — use RadioV2 or RadioGroup instead.
